verdict.rationale: AgentMail creates and hosts its own inboxes via API. Nothing in the evidence shows it connecting external Gmail, Microsoft 365, or IMAP accounts and working them from one place. The IMAP/SMTP doc covers the reverse direction: outside clients like Outlook connecting to an AgentMail inbox. Organization-wide thread retrieval spans only AgentMail's own inboxes, so neither counts as multi-provider account aggregation.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place
